अप्लुत a. (f. ता) Not protracted, as a vowel (in gram.).
आप्लव m. 1. Bathing; 2. sprinkling water on all sides.
आप्लाव m. The same as आप्लव q.v.
आप्लव-व्रतिन् m. a householder who has passed through the first order. (Also आप्लुतव्रतिन्.)
